name: pickup_shutdown
description: Pickup::Shutdown clears the primary and network pickup spawn lists, then clears and frees the global pickup respawn queue.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x41ccd0 calls PickupSpawnList::Clear on g_PickupSpawnList_Primary and g_PickupSpawnList_NetworkCopy, then tailcalls PickupRespawnQueue::ClearAndFree on g_PickupRespawnQueue.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x41ccd0 has no warnings or tags and shows the same two spawn-list clears followed by the respawn-queue clear tailcall.
The dependency frontier for 0x41ccd0 has no visible source blockers after accepting PickupSpawnList::Clear and PickupRespawnQueue::ClearAndFree.
The native pickup_shutdown_smoke builds primary, network-copy, and respawn queue entries and verifies Shutdown clears them while resetting the primary next-pickup id through PickupSpawnList::Clear.
